reviewer.method: Parent personally read complete available publisher early-publication text, all references and all three publisher figure GIFs; a truncated initial display was repaired by an untruncated lines135-260 read. patient_identity.statement: Patient1 is the corresponding unrelated Chinese girl, aged14, with the reported clinical history.
limitations: Source pedigree labels are inconsistent: Methods use family1/2-II-2, figure/legend A/B-II-1; clinical Patient1/2 identification retained, not silently repaired.

genotype.statement: Source explicitly reports heterozygous TUBA4A c.679C>T, p.L227F, NM_006000 in both girls.
limitations: Source does not give transcript version. Methods use GRCh37, while packet supplies hg38 genomic coordinates; exact coordinate conversion not independently checked. WGS/WES wording conflicts within source.

segregation.statement: Family segregation analysis reports this variant as de novo in both unrelated families.

phase.statement: Single reported heterozygous dominant variant; no compound-heterozygous phase claim is required.
limitations: No independent haplotype/parentage verification performed.

causal_confidence.statement: The packet labels the allele PATHOGENIC; the source explicitly classifies it Likely pathogenic (PS2+PM2+PP3). The article proposes causality using recurrence, de novo segregation and aggregation observations, not independent clinical validation.
limitations: Contradiction is the formal classification label, not a conclusion that the gene association is false. Overexpression cytotoxicity also occurs with wild-type; two cases and cell models have transfer limits.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every supplied phenotype item was compared; the packet is a selected clinical signature, not all reported findings.
limitations: Source adds clinical context and biopsy ultrastructure beyond packet; supplements remain unread; omitted phenotypes are not inferred negatives.

assessment.statement: Coding/protein change and heterozygosity correspond to the source; packet transcript/protein versions and hg38 base coordinate are more specific than the reported text.
limitations: No independent reference-sequence remapping in this source-only audit.
